references.text: The prophecy that the blind will receive sight, a miracle Jesus performs and which the blind man in John 9:32 confirms is without parallel in history.
God's promise to open the eyes of the blind, which is the central theme in John 9:32 where Jesus opens the eyes of a man born blind.
Messianic prophecy that the blind will see, fulfilled concretely in John 9:32 through Jesus' miracle.
Jesus' own reference to this prophecy in the Gospel of Luke, emphasizing that he is the one who opens the eyes of the blind, a miracle described as unique in John 9:32.
